reviewNotes: Held back: the page gives no year for the tune; the score has bars of another length (bar 8, 9), which the solfa grid does not draw. Imported from CCEH tune 001186 (the melody read from 001186a.mid, checked against the page's do-re-mi incipit, note for note); check the notes and the bar lines against a hymn book you trust, then set "reviewed": true. The bar lines are those of CCEH's Noteworthy score (001186a.nwc). The tune ends on D, neither doh nor lah: it may be modal; the doh is the key signature's.
